setting: walking down the hill from the hospital at twenty past eight, boots on wet grit, breath close on the microphone, a bus pulling away halfway through, one long pause where he stops to look at the sky and then carries on mid sentence
her kitchen at midday in half term, a radiator ticking, papers moved about on the table between sentences, the fridge starting up under everything, her voice flat and tired and speeding up at the end
the walk home after the fourth night in a row, snow underfoot going to slush, his steps uneven, two long silences, a car passing very slowly, the last sentence begun twice and left unfinished

the bottom of the hill on a bright cold Friday morning, gulls somewhere above, the roster paper being unfolded and refolded near the microphone, his voice slower than usual and one short laugh at the end
